name: Hotel Savoy, a Rocco Forte Hotel
positioning: Rocco Forte hotel on Florence's Piazza della Repubblica, first opened in 1893, with interiors by Olga Polizzi
best_for: Travelers who want a base on Piazza della Repubblica in central Florence
Art lovers, with artworks for sale in the Artist Suites
Food and cocktail lovers, with Irene and Bar Artemisia on site

facts.text: Hotel Savoy is at Piazza della Repubblica 7 in Florence.
The Savoy first opened its doors to guests in 1893.
Sir Rocco Forte acquired the property in 1998 and carried out a top-to-toe renovation.
The interiors were re-imagined by Olga Polizzi, Director of Design for Rocco Forte Hotels and Sir Rocco's sister.
Most rooms have views of the Duomo or Piazza della Repubblica.
The rooms showcase fine Tuscan silks and local artwork.
Marble bathrooms are stocked with Irene Forte organic bath products made by Sir Rocco's daughter.
Irene is the hotel's trattoria, named in honour of Lady Forte.
Chef Fulvio Pierangelini's menu at Irene is a delicate take on authentic Tuscan food.
The Irene restaurant and Artemisia Cocktail Bar re-opened in spring 2025 after a major re-fit.
At Bar Artemisia, Maestro Salvatore Calabrese and his team reinvent aperitivo cocktails.
The subterranean gym has Technogym equipment and a dedicated fitness studio.

highlights.text: Irene features Loro Piana fabrics, hand-blown Venetian chandeliers and Pietrasanta marble.
The Artist Suites host artworks by contemporary artists that are available for purchase.
Artemisia Gentileschi, the bar's namesake, pioneered artistic expression in 17th-century Florence.
Irene's terrace on Piazza della Repubblica offers front-row views of city life.
In a mixology class, guests learn to make the Negroni and discover its origins in Florence.

considerations.text: There is no dress code, but guests are asked to avoid sportswear, shorts and beach shoes in the restaurants.
WhataHotel notes possible city noise from the busy piazza location.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning and prime location.
